description: Searches what Marsell remembers about the business: facts (its name, site, description, audience, voice, whose accounts posts come from, the facts the owner confirmed and the owner's answers), the owner's own rules and preferences (these always win), and the active learnings the planning passes wrote, each with its confidence, when it was last confirmed and how much evidence backs it. Use it before stating what the business is or what has worked; the owner's own facts in their hand are owner_facts_read, the design language business_context_read.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

q.description: Words to narrow the confirmed facts, answers, rules and learnings by: one is kept when it holds any word of three letters or more, any case. The business's name, site, audience and voice always come back. null returns everything.

name: memory_search
